ConceptDef.label: Work rules
ConceptDef.helpText: A RULE sets one Work type's priority for every colonist it matches, including ones who arrive later.\n\nNothing changes until you press APPLY.

ConceptDef.label: Specific jobs
ConceptDef.helpText: Every Work type contains smaller jobs. Ctrl-click a Work type's header to set priorities for one SPECIFIC JOB instead of the whole Work type.

ConceptDef.label: Suggested rules
ConceptDef.helpText: These suggestions are read from your current Work tab. Keep, edit, or skip each one.\n\nOnly the ones you KEEP are saved.
